propositions: A TOCTOU race in completion close reads HEAD independently during verify and sign phases, allowing an unrelated commit to land between them and cause the ticket to close without a completion signature.

When HEAD drifts between verify and sign, the pre-sign drift guard correctly refuses to attest the stale state, but the close transition proceeds anyway, leaving the ticket closed and unsigned with no recovery path.

The current suggested recovery (re-close to certify) is a no-op because the ticket is already closed, and only --force-close or manual manifest fabrication are available, neither of which are acceptable.
The default code path (no --ref argument) still reads HEAD twice and remains vulnerable; the 80af --ref fix only made the explicit --ref path coherent.
